title: PackageCommit
description: Immutable runtime batch receipt with exact accepted sequence and state revision.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

launch_session_id.description: Active session that submitted a valid batch.
launch_session_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

sco_state_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

payload_digest.description: Digest of canonical request envelope and mutations.

first_sequence.description: First sequence in this receipt, or next expected sequence for an empty finalization.

mutation_count.description: Number of typed mutations accepted atomically.

state_revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision used for compare-and-swap.

finalized.description: True if this receipt closed the run-time session.

x-invariants: A repeated payload cannot award duplicate time or evidence.
Receipt exists only after atomic state and outbox commit.
